## Log File
*On the "Patching Failed" page, click "Show Log File in Finder" and drag the `HLPatcher-failure-....zip` file it shows into this box.
It already holds your HLPatcher version, Mac, build tools, selected games, options and the full patching log, 
so you don't need to type any of that.*


## What Happened
*Anything the log file can't show: what you were doing, whether it fails the same way every time
and whether "Stable" patching mode fails too*


## Terminal Output
*Only if the "Patching Failed" page had no "Show Log File in Finder" button: paste the entire terminal output*
```
Paste the terminal output here
```

## Checklist
- [ ] I have attached the log file from the "Patching Failed" page
- [ ] I have tried patching again using "Stable" patching mode
- [ ] I have installed Xcode Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --install`)
- [ ] I have checked that this issue hasn't been reported before
